name: phyllotaxis
title: Phyllotaxis
description: Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then one Fibonacci arm turns accent and pulses outward while the head slowly turns.
useWhen: An opener or section break should grow something natural and precise in about two seconds, then keep a gentle idle motion.
A story about growth, nature, design systems or the golden ratio needs a literal, recognisable pattern.
One element of many needs to be singled out, with the accent arm drawing the eye along a spiral path.
avoidWhen: The figure should be built from straight threads and morph between shapes: use string-art.
The moment calls for a one-shot burst that clears the frame.
The scene needs a texture with no focal point: use flow-field.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Arm spacing
variables.description: Every n-th seed forms one arm; a Fibonacci number reads best.

variables.label: Grow frames
variables.description: Frames for all seeds to spiral out.

variables.label: Pulse frames
variables.description: Frames per pulse along the accent arm once grown.

variables.label: Rotation
variables.description: Slow rotation of the head in degrees per second; 0 holds still.
